topic: Saving receipts vs guessing at tax time (Owen vs Hope)

scenes.narration: Saved receipts can mean three thousand more back from the IRS. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding up a refund check printed THREE THOUSAND, comic burst banner reads SAVE THE PAPER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Owen and Hope are freelance designers earning fifty thousand last year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man owen and woman hope at home offices with sketch tablets and laptops, ledger sheets labeled FIFTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both work from home most days for the same kinds of clients.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two home offices side by side, identical mood boards and client invoices on the walls, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Owen throws receipts away as soon as they arrive.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, owen tossing a pile of crumpled receipts into a trash can, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He tells himself he will remember every expense at tax time.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, owen relaxing on a couch with a thought bubble full of question marks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hope scans each receipt into a free phone app immediately.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, hope at a coffee shop scanning a receipt into a phone app, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She tracks her car mileage and tags each expense category.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, hope's phone showing a mileage log and tagged categories labeled HOME OFFICE, MILES, MEALS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At tax time Owen guesses twelve hundred dollars of expenses.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, owen at a desk with a tax form, scribbling TWELVE HUNDRED next to expenses, a giant question mark above him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He writes the guessed number on his return to be safe.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, owen filing a tax return online with a banner reading PLAYING IT SAFE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hope's app printed forty four hundred dollars in real expenses.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, hope holding a printout from her app reading TOTAL EXPENSES FORTY FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She got eight hundred dollars more in her refund than Owen.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side owen with a thin refund check, right side hope with a thicker check labeled EIGHT HUNDRED MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Save every receipt with a free app. The IRS honors proof. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a phone with a receipt scanner app open, comic banner reads SCAN AS YOU GO, kids comic book illustration
